dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge with a non-uniform concave spline, featuring multiple irregular indentations in the upper third of the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, rounded but significantly jagged due to a deep posterior notch immediately below the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree upward slope relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 2.8:1 ratio of maximum visible base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notches and irregular serrations on the upper trailing edge; multiple horizontal rake marks (parallel linear depigmentation) on the lower flank; several small, white punctate circular marks scattered across the lower third of the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent white circular spot located on the anterior dorsal ridge just before the leading edge of the fin.
